2	-- INTERVIEW SCHEDULING: Availability, Interviews, Booking Tokens
3	-- ============================================================
4	
5	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
6	-- 1. AVAILABILITY SLOTS
7	--    Recruiters define their weekly availability windows.
8	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9	
10	CREATE TABLE public.availability_slots (
11	  id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
12	  user_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
13	  team_id      uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
14	  day_of_week  integer NOT NULL CHECK (day_of_week BETWEEN 0 AND 6), -- 0=Sun, 6=Sat
15	  start_time   time NOT NULL,
16	  end_time     time NOT NULL,
17	  timezone     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
18	  is_active    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
19	  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
20	  CHECK (start_time < end_time)
21	);
22	
23	CREATE INDEX idx_availability_user ON public.availability_slots(user_id, day_of_week);
24	CREATE INDEX idx_availability_team ON public.availability_slots(team_id);
25	
26	ALTER TABLE public.availability_slots ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
27	
28	-- Users manage their own availability
29	CREATE POLICY "Users can manage own availability"
30	  ON public.availability_slots FOR ALL
31	  TO authenticated
32	  USING (user_id = auth.uid());
33	
34	-- Team members can view any member's availability (for scheduling)
35	CREATE POLICY "Team members can view team availability"
36	  ON public.availability_slots FOR SELECT
37	  TO authenticated
38	  USING (
39	    team_id IS NOT NULL
40	    AND EXISTS (
41	      SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members tm
42	      WHERE tm.team_id = availability_slots.team_id
43	        AND tm.user_id = auth.uid()
44	    )
45	  );
46	
47	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
48	-- 2. INTERVIEWS
49	--    Scheduled interview records.
50	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
51	
52	CREATE TABLE public.interviews (
53	  id               uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
54	  job_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
55	  resume_id        uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
56	  interviewer_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
57	  candidate_name   text NOT NULL,
58	  candidate_email  text,
59	  scheduled_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
60	  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
61	  status           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled'
62	                     CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show')),
63	  meeting_link     text,
64	  notes            text,
65	  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
66	  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
67	);
68	
69	CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_job        ON public.interviews(job_id);
70	CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_resume     ON public.interviews(resume_id);
71	CREATE INDEX idx_interviews_interviewer ON public.interviews(interviewer_id, scheduled_at);
72	
73	ALTER TABLE public.interviews ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
74	
75	-- Team owners and the job owner can view all interviews for a job
76	CREATE POLICY "Team can view interviews"
77	  ON public.interviews FOR SELECT
78	  TO authenticated
79	  USING (
80	    interviewer_id = auth.uid()
81	    OR EXISTS (
82	      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
83	      WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id
84	        AND (
85	          j.user_id = auth.uid()
86	          OR (
87	            j.team_id IS NOT NULL
88	            AND EXISTS (
89	              SELECT 1 FROM public.team_members tm
90	              WHERE tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid()
91	            )
92	          )
93	        )
94	    )
95	  );
96	
97	-- Interviewers can manage their own; job owner can manage all for the job
98	CREATE POLICY "Team can manage interviews"
99	  ON public.interviews FOR ALL
100	  TO authenticated
101	  USING (
102	    interviewer_id = auth.uid()
103	    OR EXISTS (
104	      SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j
105	      WHERE j.id = interviews.job_id AND j.user_id = auth.uid()
106	    )
107	  );
108	
109	-- updated_at trigger
110	CREATE TRIGGER set_interviews_updated_at
111	  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.interviews
112	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
113

115	-- 3. BOOKING TOKENS
116	--    Single-use tokens sent to candidates for self-booking.
117	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
118	
119	CREATE TABLE public.booking_tokens (
120	  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
121	  job_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
122	  resume_id       uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
123	  interviewer_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
124	  token           text NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(24), 'hex'),
125	  duration_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
126	  expires_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '7 days'),
127	  used            boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
128	  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
129	);
130	
131	CREATE INDEX idx_booking_tokens_token        ON public.booking_tokens(token);
132	CREATE INDEX idx_booking_tokens_interviewer  ON public.booking_tokens(interviewer_id);
133	
134	ALTER TABLE public.booking_tokens ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
135	
136	-- Interviewers manage their own tokens
137	CREATE POLICY "Interviewers can manage own tokens"
138	  ON public.booking_tokens FOR ALL
139	  TO authenticated
140	  USING (interviewer_id = auth.uid());

1	# Tier 2 Differentiators — Build the 3 Missing Features
2	
3	## Context
4	Tier 2 audit shows 8 of 11 features already exist. Three gaps remain:
5	1. **WhatsApp integration** — completely missing, huge differentiator in India/SEA/LATAM/MENA
6	2. **One-click rejection emails with AI feedback** — only generic email outreach exists
7	3. **Open API documentation page** — API mentioned in pricing but no docs/playground
8	
9	## Build Plan
10	
11	### Feature 1: WhatsApp Integration (via wa.me deep links + Twilio API)
12	
13	**Approach:** Two tiers — immediate (wa.me deep links, no API needed) + future (Twilio WhatsApp API for automated messages).
14	
15	**MVP (build now):** wa.me deep links for one-click messaging from candidate cards.
16	
17	**DB Migration** — `supabase/migrations/20260409000000_whatsapp_and_api.sql`
18	- Add `whatsapp_number` to `profiles` table (recruiter's WhatsApp number)
19	- Add `phone` column to `resumes` table if not exists (candidate phone from parsed resume)
20	
21	**Component** — `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppButton.tsx`
22	- Props: `candidatePhone, candidateName, jobTitle, messageTemplate?`
23	- Generates wa.me link: `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodedMessage}`
24	- Default template: "Hi {name}, regarding your application for {jobTitle} at our company..."
25	- Opens in new tab
26	- Shows WhatsApp icon (green) button
27	
28	**WhatsApp Templates** — `src/components/WhatsAppTemplateManager.tsx`
29	- Settings component for managing message templates
30	- Pre-built templates: Interview Invite, Application Update, Document Request, Offer Discussion
31	- Template variables: `{{candidate_name}}`, `{{job_title}}`, `{{interview_date}}`
32	- Stored in localStorage initially (no DB needed for MVP)
33	
34	**Integration points:**
35	- Add WhatsApp button to `CandidateDetailSheet.tsx` action bar (alongside Email/Call)
36	- Add WhatsApp button to `CandidateRow.tsx` (if phone number available)
37	- Add WhatsApp number field to `Settings.tsx` or `Profile.tsx`
38	- Show in KanbanBoard cards (small icon if phone available)
39	
40	### Feature 2: One-Click Rejection Emails with AI Feedback
41	
42	**Edge Function** — `supabase/functions/generate-rejection/index.ts`
43	- Auth required
44	- Input: `{ candidate_name, job_title, strengths, gaps, missing_skills }`
45	- Uses GPT-4o to generate personalized, empathetic rejection email
46	- Returns: `{ subject, body }` with constructive feedback (what was strong, areas to develop)
47	- Tone: professional, encouraging, specific — not generic "we regret to inform you"
48	
49	**Component** — `src/components/candidate/RejectWithFeedbackDialog.tsx`
50	- Props: `resumeId, jobId, candidateName, candidateEmail, result (scores/gaps/strengths)`
51	- On open: calls generate-rejection edge function with candidate data
52	- Shows generated email preview (editable subject + body)
53	- "Send & Reject" button: sends email via Resend + updates candidate stage to "rejected"
54	- Loading state during generation
55	- Option to skip AI and use a simple template
56	
57	**Integration:**
58	- Add "Reject with Feedback" button in CandidateDetailSheet
59	- Add to KanbanBoard — when dropping into "Rejected" column, offer dialog
60	- Add to ApplicationsTab — status change to "rejected" can trigger the dialog
61	- Track rejection emails sent in a log
62	
63	### Feature 3: Open API Documentation Page
64	
65	**Page** — `src/pages/ApiDocs.tsx`
66	- Route: `/api-docs` (protected, only visible to users on Growth/Agency plans)
67	- Sections:
68	  - Authentication (API key generation + display)
69	  - Endpoints reference (jobs, candidates, results, applications)
70	  - Code examples (curl, JavaScript, Python)
71	  - Webhooks configuration
72	  - Rate limits
73	
74	**DB Migration** (in same file `20260409000000_whatsapp_and_api.sql`)
75	- `api_keys` table: id, user_id, team_id, key_hash (SHA-256), prefix (first 8 chars for display), name, created_at, last_used_at, revoked
76	- RLS: user can manage own keys
77	
78	**API Key Management Component** — `src/components/ApiKeyManager.tsx`
79	- Generate new API key (show once, then only prefix)
80	- List existing keys with name, prefix, created date, last used
81	- Revoke keys
82	- Copy key to clipboard
83	
84	**Edge Function** — `supabase/functions/public-api/index.ts`
85	- Validates API key from `Authorization: Bearer rk_...` header
86	- Routes: GET /jobs, GET /jobs/:id/candidates, GET /jobs/:id/results, POST /jobs
87	- Returns JSON responses
88	- Rate limiting: 100 req/min per key
89	
90	**Webhook Config** — `src/components/WebhookManager.tsx`
91	- Configure webhook URLs for events: application_received, ranking_complete, stage_changed
92	- Test webhook button (sends sample payload)
93	- Stored in DB: `webhook_configs` table
94	
95	**Integration:**
96	- Add "API" to sidebar nav (only for Growth/Agency plans)
97	- Add `/api-docs` route to App.tsx
98	- Show API key in Settings page for eligible plans

-- ============================================================
-- WHATSAPP + API KEYS + WEBHOOKS
-- ============================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. PROFILES: WhatsApp number for recruiters
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.profiles
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_number text;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. API KEYS
--    One API key per user/team, hashed, with prefix for display.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.api_keys (
  id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id      uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- key_hash stores SHA-256 of the full key; never store plaintext
  key_hash     text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  -- prefix: first 12 chars of full key (safe to display, not enough to brute-force)
  prefix       text NOT NULL,
  name         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'My API Key',
  last_used_at timestamptz,
  revoked      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_api_keys_user    ON public.api_keys(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_api_keys_hash    ON public.api_keys(key_hash) WHERE NOT revoked;

ALTER TABLE public.api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Users manage own API keys"
  ON public.api_keys FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. WEBHOOK CONFIGS
--    Webhook endpoints per user, with event subscriptions.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.webhook_configs (
  id         uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id    uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  url        text NOT NULL,
  -- events: JSON array of event strings e.g. ["job.created","ranking.completed"]
  events     jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  secret     text NOT NULL DEFAULT encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex'),
  active     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_webhook_configs_user ON public.webhook_configs(user_id);

ALTER TABLE public.webhook_configs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Users manage own webhooks"
  ON public.webhook_configs FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE TRIGGER set_webhook_configs_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.webhook_configs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
